note: Ground-floor weeks room (busy). Feminine nouns on the left (la semaine, la date, la canicule), the adjectives (hebdomadaire, dominical) left of centre, masculine on the right (dimanche, le rendez-vous, juin, lundi, vendredi, samedi, septembre, le week-end). The wooden door on the far left goes back to the seasons room; the archway on the right leads to the adverbs hall. Zoom: the round side table with the linen cloth in front.
